original_intent.statement: Provide browser automation, debugging, performance, network, screenshot, form, and JavaScript inspection through Chrome DevTools.
original_intent.source: Reconstructed from the legacy canonical SKILL.md before the MCP migration.

revisions.intent: For development and QA agents, use the official Chrome DevTools MCP for live browser interaction and browser-visible E2E verification after implementation, with Windows and headed-session guidance and evidence-based reporting.
success_criteria: Agents route suitable post-implementation browser checks through Chrome DevTools MCP.
Agents use current MCP page, snapshot, interaction, console, network, screenshot, and performance tools.
Agents distinguish PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and NOT RUN from static or missing evidence.
Agents preserve existing project E2E runners for repeatable CI coverage.
non_goals: Replacing Playwright, Cypress, or another project E2E runner.
Launching a browser when no browser evidence is needed.
Entering credentials or modifying server-side data outside the authorized test scope.

approval.source: User request dated 2026-09-21 to set up Chrome DevTools and encourage its use for E2E after implementation.
